name: Hesperian Union
note: Fictional EU-style supranational union of western island-states (the Hesperides), sharing a common legal order of directives and regulations. Exists only as synthetic test material: it exercises the supranational Article-based hierarchy (Chapter/Article/Paragraph/Point) and the enacting/adopting register of directly-applicable regulations and transposed directives, so the corpus can stand in as the acquis side of a compliance-comparison pair. Not a real body; carries no real instruments and no real jurisdiction's law.

directive.label: Directive
directive.note: Requires transposition into the national law of member states.

regulation.label: Regulation
regulation.note: Directly applicable in all member states without transposition.

frbr.note: Instruments identified by a running number and the year of adoption, e.g. Directive 12 of 2004 at /akn/xu/act/2004/12.

numbering.note: Directives and regulations cited by doctype, number and year (e.g. 'Directive 12 of 2004', 'Regulation 5 of 2009').

enacting_formulae.text: THE ASSEMBLY OF THE HESPERIAN UNION AND THE HESPERIAN COUNCIL, Having regard to the Treaty establishing the Hesperian Union, HAS ADOPTED THIS DIRECTIVE:
THE ASSEMBLY OF THE HESPERIAN UNION AND THE HESPERIAN COUNCIL, Having regard to the Treaty establishing the Hesperian Union, HAS ADOPTED THIS REGULATION:

amendments.phrasing: Article X is replaced by the following: / Article Y is deleted / the following Article is inserted:

core_tlcs.showAs: The Assembly of the Hesperian Union
Official Journal of the Hesperian Union

structuring.prompt_additions: Body-fill task only. Preserve citations, inline markup, and list numbering verbatim. Recitals appear as numbered paragraphs in the preamble before the adopting formula; ARTICLE is the basic unit and SECTION, where present, is a higher division above it. Never emit structural keywords: the scaffold owns hierarchy.

validation.note: Synthetic reference jurisdiction. Three Bluebell-authored instruments (a framework directive, a directly-applicable regulation and an amending directive) round-trip through parse_to_akn to schema-valid, zero-advisory-error AKN structured as numbered articles and paragraphs (experiments/synthetic_scans).
